title: Actual horizontal tensor restriction preserves evaluated pure tensors
statement:
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)


theorem evaluation_tensor_transition_pure {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj M).val.obj U)
    (y : ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj N).val.obj U) :
    (ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ n M N).hom.val.app U
      (((transition.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h).app _).val.app U
        ((ordinaryEvaluationTensor.{c, v, r} J B τ m M N).inv.val.app U
          (tensorSection.{c, v, r} J (B m) _ _ U x y))) =
      tensorSection.{c, v, r} J (B n) _ _ U
        (((transition.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h).app M).val.app U x)
        (((transition.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h).app N).val.app U y)

source.place: Tags 03EK and 03EL: the sheaf tensor pairing is natural under restriction; Zheng Construction 4.1: actual horizontal restrictions of coefficient systems.

proof.text: Choose sequence-site sections corresponding to the two arbitrary evaluated sections, using the canonical evaluation section identification.

The inverse evaluation tensor comparison sends the evaluated pure tensor to the evaluation of the sequence-site pure tensor. The actual horizontal map is restriction along the level-arrow with identity site component. Naturality of tensorSection sends this restriction to the tensor of the restricted operands. Apply the evaluation pure formula at the lower index and the horizontal section cast formulas for the operands.

Transport the resulting equality along the two chosen section equalities by congrArg₂. This yields the claim for arbitrary evaluated sections. The case of equal indices uses the same functorial restriction formula; no invertibility, flatness or nonzero coefficient hypothesis is needed.
